title: Great App!
body:
Due to the time change this past weekend I have been looking for something to replace the app I was using for medicine reminders.  

I have a complicated and complex medicine schedule.  The app I was using changed the times I had set up in it for reminders - moved them an hour ahead and the only way to change them back was manually.  I did that for Sunday thinking that Monday would have the correct times.  No - they were showing up an hour earlier again.  

Wel...I began searching for a new app I could use for this purpose and found Text Me That.  I gave it a try and found it does what it says right away.  So, I signed up for a subscription immediately.  

The one thing that I would like to see added to TMT is the ability to customize schedules. I have med that is to be every other day and so I’ve had to resort to using another app to remind me for it.  It would be great if the developers would make the app where those of us who need it could specify that the reminder is every 2 days, every 3 days, etc.

As far as I’m concerned this is the only thing missing from an otherwise great app!

title: Fees too high
body:
Setup was easy. I got my code and everything seems to work until I try to send. Then I’m asked to subscribe to a monthly $5 plan or an annual $42 plan. (Same features at a reduced $3.50 monthly rate paid in advance.)
There was no way to try the 15 free texts because there’s no keyboard I’m guessing you have to buy the monthly subscription to get the 14 day free trial. Then I’ll never The the subscription fee refunded even if a keyboard appears. 
I was under the impression based on a previous app description saying I could use the app 15 times monthly for free without needing a subscription. In a reply from the developer he said he’s going to try to do away with the free 15 in Version 3.0 so even if I can get this to work it will probably be short lived.

There’s also a 14 day trial period with a subscription if I chose to subscribe and cancel within the 14 days. It’s really 13 days since you must cancel the subscription at least 24 hours in advance. 

15 texts per month is more than enough for me. $5 monthly is too much for the casual user like myself even if it is for unlimited texting. 

I’ll try another Auto Text app that earns credits by watching ads. That’s fine with me. There’s another app for $2 per month with worked flawlessly before the developer screwed it up with an update introducing bugs and removing features. He also bypassed Apple by asking for your credit card info before you could give it a test run. I wouldn’t give my credit card info in principle to bypass Apple’s cut.

I will try to get it to work before the trial period is up or I’ll delete it and move on.

This is my sixth auto text app because all have gone belly up due to unreasonable subscriptions fees or they just stop working and vanish from the AppStore.

Good Luck to the developer. I hope he succeeds with his present business model or can manage to lower fees.

For now I’ll stick with Apple’s native Reminders which sends friends a Notification to do something based on a future time or location I set. The only drawback is it won’t work with the Android world.

title: SAVED MY LIFE
body:
Let’s start at the beginning. I was shot in the head a while back. The time when the fidget spinners were on the rise, I stole one from a “friend” of mine. It just so happened he was on the edge of his seat with things going on in his life that made him angry and he was ready to explode. He also had high temper and anger problems. 
I was at his house. He was having a small party (or more like his wife was having small party) just to have fun. He had a pool in his backyard of his house with a grill and a bar. After the night was starting to end and everyone has had a few drinks Jim (his name’s Jim) was standing in the bar about to pour me another drink. 
Long story short he was using a fidget spinner because he fidgets a lot and has to always be doing something with his hands. For some reason I thought it’d be a good idea to take it from him. I think I just wanted to try it and see what the big deal was, but because I drank some already I didn’t ask for permission. I took it straight from his hands and he got furious. 
He was known for acting violently without thinking sometimes plus he was drunk plus he had anger issues plus there was a lot going on in his life and he was pushed right over the edge with me taking the fidget spinner from him.
He grabbed a shotgun from underneath the bar that he keeps for security reasons. Without a second thought he fires at me. At that exact moment is when I got a text from TEXT ME THAT to remind me to do my weekly stretches. As I looked down at my phone bullets flew where my head was supposed to be. I would have died if it were not for TMT. 
Although, one bullet did make it to me. It hit me in the head, I was rushed to the hospital when Jim realized how he just acted. The bullet wound hit me in the right spot to give me short term memory loss. Now, when my wife tells me to do chores sometimes I have the excuse to say “I forgot, I WAS shot in the head you know”. Thanks Text Me That. My life couldn’t be better!
